item.title: Family & Education First, A Career In Law Up Next - TM Times
item.description: GRAND FORKS, ND — The University of North Dakota (UND) School of Law is quite fortunate to have two smart, accomplished students from the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa currently enrolled in their program, two young women who have a passion for law and the same passion to advocate for Native Nations.
